units.title: SG-5.6.2 Scene unit tests with Phaser mocked cover the scene behaviors through the @game alias
Act: Add @game paths mapping to game/tsconfig.json
Act: Confirm buildScene and SceneObject expose ordering and visibility behavior
Act: Confirm hover, click and fallback paths in SceneObject and BootScene
Verify: game tsconfig @game alias unit tests

tests.name: maps @game/* to ./src/*
tests.title: tsconfig @game alias: maps @game/* to ./src/*
tests.scenario: Given the game tsconfig.json on disk, When compilerOptions.paths['@game/*'] is read, Then it equals ['./src/*']
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/tsconfigAlias.test.ts --testTimeout=10000
tests.detail: Passed on first run; the mapping already exists in the working tree.

tests.id: tsconfigAlias.test.ts::resolves the mapped ./src target to an existing directory
tests.name: resolves the mapped ./src target to an existing directory
tests.title: tsconfig @game alias: resolves the mapped ./src target to an existing directory
tests.scenario: Given the game tsconfig.json mapping for @game/*, When the mapped target is resolved relative to the game folder, Then the src directory exists on disk (existsSync)
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/tsconfigAlias.test.ts --testTimeout=10000
tests.detail: Passed on first run; game/src exists.

units.title: Verify: Scene layer ordering, entity creation and visibility unit tests via @game

tests.name: orders objects out of authored order by ascending depth
tests.title: returns objects in ascending depth order when they are authored out of layer order
tests.scenario: Given objects authored as ui, background, characters, furniture; When buildScene runs; Then depths are ascending and equal layerDepth for background, furniture, characters, ui

tests.name: creates one sprite per object with spec key/x/y/scale
tests.title: creates one sprite per authored object with key, position and scale taken from the spec
tests.scenario: Given three authored objects with distinct asset, position and scale; When buildScene runs; Then createSprite is called scene.objects.length times with matching key, x, y and scale

tests.name: shows and hides an object following its visibleWhen flag
tests.title: shows and hides an object following its visibleWhen flag through sync
tests.scenario: Given an object gated on flag 'a' and state without the flag; When sync(state without flag) then sync(setFlag(state, 'a', true)); Then setVisible calls are [[false],[true]]

units.title: Verify: Scene hover, click and missing-asset fallback unit tests with Phaser mocked via @game

tests.name: highlights and shows the label on hover in then out
tests.title: scene hover and click via @game > highlights and shows the label on hover in then out
tests.scenario: Given a visible object with a captured hover callback, When hover true then false, Then setHighlighted and setLabelVisible are called [[true],[false]]
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/sceneAliasInteraction.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: calls the interact listener with the object id and its actions on click after sync
tests.title: scene hover and click via @game > calls the interact listener with the object id and its actions on click after sync
tests.scenario: Given a visible synced object with a listener, When clicked, Then the listener is called with objectId and actions
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/sceneAliasInteraction.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: calls nothing on click while the object is hidden
tests.title: scene hover and click via @game > calls nothing on click while the object is hidden
tests.scenario: Given an object hidden by an unset visibleWhen flag, When clicked, Then the listener is not called
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/sceneAliasInteraction.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: resolves an id that is not in the manifest to FALLBACK_KEY
tests.title: missing-asset fallback via @game > resolves an id that is not in the manifest to FALLBACK_KEY
tests.scenario: Given a manifest without 'nope', When resolving 'nope', Then FALLBACK_KEY is returned
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/sceneAliasInteraction.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: plans an unknown scene asset reference instead of loading it
tests.title: missing-asset fallback via @game > plans an unknown scene asset reference instead of loading it
tests.scenario: Given the scene references objects/ghost which is not in the manifest, When planPreload runs, Then it is reported unknown and not loaded
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/sceneAliasInteraction.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: does not call load.image for an unknown asset ref and generates FALLBACK_KEY
tests.title: missing-asset fallback via @game > does not call load.image for an unknown asset ref and generates FALLBACK_KEY
tests.scenario: Given the mocked scene references objects/ghost missing from the manifest, When BootScene.preload runs, Then load.image is not called for objects/ghost and the fallback texture is generated under FALLBACK_KEY
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/sceneAliasInteraction.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

units.title: REQ · game tsconfig resolves the @game alias
REQ · Scene suite proves layer ordering, content-to-entity creation and visibility via @game
REQ · Scene suite proves hover, click and missing-asset fallback with Phaser mocked via @game
Evidence: Scene alias unit tests cover the five behaviors and pass together
